check: Board P model-reference and alignment changes only
comparison_method: Parse both PCB files with scripts/schgen/sexp.py; recursively remove only model nodes; require exact equality of every remaining s-expression. Hash the resulting tree serialized with compact JSON separators.
model_path_change: Rebased embedded model references from five parent levels to the two levels required by the active boards/board-p project directory. Canonical footprint paths already used two levels.
usb_alignment_method: Compare the four WRL shell-leg bounding-box centers (vertices at X magnitude >4 mm and Z<-0.59 mm) against footprint slot centers. Imported WRL coordinates are scaled by2.54 mm and the existing180 degree model rotation is retained.
scope: Only model references and J1 model translation changed. This adds no electrical, thermal, surge, assembly or exact manufacturer-model qualification.
